profile.name: David Heffler
profile.title: Full-Stack Web Developer | Mathematics Student @ MSJC

about: Fullstack software engineer with 4+ years of professional experience, currently balancing entrepreneurship with academics. Outside of work and school, I enjoy photography, hiking, chess, Tetris, rhythm games, and maintaining my cactus garden.

experience.title: Founder & Lead Engineer
experience.description: A DRM and anti-tamper platform serving thousands of users across its tenants, with five-figure revenue. Protection is the core. Identity, payments, analytics, support, and marketing grew up around it because the products we protect needed them.
bullets: Built the protection pipeline: layered bytecode obfuscation, native compilation of sensitive code paths, per-user watermarked builds, and runtime anti-debug and integrity checks.

Designed licensing and device trust from scratch. Fuzzy hardware fingerprinting with per-device slots replaced brittle HWID locks, and a risk scoring engine weighs payment, identity, velocity, and device signals.
Run our own identity provider (OAuth 2.1, JWT/JWKS issuer) with hardware-bound sessions and keypair grants, shared by every product on the platform.
Moved client traffic onto a Rust gRPC transport with end-to-end encryption, and shipped a zero-knowledge vault where the server only ever holds ciphertext.
Shipped the commerce backend: Stripe and crypto checkout, entitlements, license keys, bundle and upgrade pricing, and a credit-based reseller network that settles its own balances.
Built first-party analytics on Cloudflare Workers with 45 event types and no third-party trackers. It feeds funnel, retention, and revenue-by-channel reporting.
Handle marketing end to end: positioning and brand voice, a creator partner program with fit scoring and referral payouts, an SEO content pipeline, and GDPR and CCPA compliance pages.
Added an AI operator layer: an MCP server for staff tooling, a RAG support assistant over our knowledge base, and an LLM moderation service.

experience.title: Founder & Technical Consultant
experience.description: Founded a web development consultancy with 10+ international clients and five-figure revenue, delivering fullstack, production-grade systems with fast iterations and reliable operations.
bullets: Architected and shipped e-commerce and B2C platforms using TypeScript, Next.js, and MongoDB.
Implemented CI/CD with Docker, Vercel, and Coolify; standardized deploy workflows, rollbacks, and environment parity.
Established operational readiness: uptime monitoring, structured logs, backups, SSL/TLS, and CDN caching.
Partnered directly with stakeholders to scope clear milestones and deliver on aggressive timelines.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer
experience.description: Contributed to an External Attack Surface Management (EASM) platform focused on scalable OSINT and security intelligence.
bullets: Engineered 20+ OSINT tools on top of a modular API framework.
Designed microservice APIs and message-driven data pipelines; improved data integrity and throughput.
Reduced ingestion latency and improved observability with structured logs and metrics.
Collaborated on data modeling and storage strategies balancing cost, speed, and retention requirements.

experience.title: Associate
experience.description: Team member at a Jet's Pizza franchise with cross-functional operational responsibilities.
bullets: Assisted with employee scheduling and large catering orders for tax-exempt organizations.
Handled daily operations including food prep, cooking, cashier duties, phones, and cleaning.
Worked effectively in a fast-paced environment while maintaining customer satisfaction.

projects.title: VANE
projects.description: Application-layer bot intelligence that detects autonomous behavior, scores entities over time, and responds automatically.
highlights: Designed and shipped a real-time signal ingestion pipeline using Redis Streams with in-process consumer workers.
Built a configurable rules engine with customer-defined conditions and automated enforcement actions (block, challenge, rate-limit, webhook).
Developed a feature-rich SDK (@usevane/core, @usevane/next, @usevane/cli, @usevane/mcp) for 30-second installs via CLI scaffolding.
Implemented AI-operated interfaces: dashboard copilot, MCP server for editor integration, and natural language rule authoring.

projects.title: haruhime.moe
projects.description: Web tools for creating and running osu! tournament events, built on open source libraries and data, with typed API clients for the osu! API and a beatmap mirror.
highlights: Built packs to bundle a mappool into one zip or torrent, keyed by a short code that rebuilds the same pool for every player.

Built pools with osu! OAuth, co-editing, a map search that applies mod effects to star rating, AR and OD, and a check against the official tournament content rules. Similar-map suggestions use precomputed embeddings from BoBERT, an open source (MIT) model by another developer.
Built bb, a BBCode editor with a live preview at osu!'s page widths and a collab banner (imagemap) maker.
Split shared code into 8 open source npm packages across 14 public repos (UI, osu! API client, pool logic, Next.js plumbing).
Set up GitHub Actions CI (Biome, TypeScript, Vitest) and npm trusted publishing with provenance, so releases ship from GitHub with no stored npm tokens.

projects.title: HIVE
projects.description: Production bio-link platform serving 1,500+ users; full-stack Next.js app with analytics dashboard, profile customization, and shareable public pages.
highlights: Next.js 16 and MongoDB app with 47 API routes, BetterAuth (email, Google and Discord OAuth) and Cloudflare R2 media storage.
Subscriptions through Stripe and crypto payments (NOWPayments) with webhook handling and redeemable codes.
Profile analytics for views, clicks, referrers and sessions; live Spotify and Discord presence widgets; embeds for YouTube, SoundCloud, X and more.
Rate limiting, AI content moderation, GDPR data export and deletion, and CI with Vitest and Playwright tests, Gitleaks secret scanning and Semgrep.

projects.title: NITROUS
projects.description: Open-source OSINT platform: a Fastify REST API with 17 lookup modules across username, email, domain, phone and IP, plus a Next.js search frontend.
highlights: Plugin-style module architecture: each lookup extends one base class and loads automatically, and a single request can fan out across a whole category.
Documented the API with OpenAPI, and secured it with Helmet, a CORS allowlist and per-environment rate limits.
Published a typed TypeScript SDK (nitrous.ts) on npm and a Raycast extension on top of the API.
